chars.NARRATOR: a skinny 20-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black track pants and white sneakers
chars.SISTERINLAW: a Moroccan woman in her late twenties wearing a bright turquoise house djellaba with white trim and a loose beige headscarf, gold hoop earrings
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman of about 20 with long straight black hair in a high ponytail, wearing a red puffer jacket, ripped light-blue jeans and big silver hoop earrings
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan man of 26 with a short trimmed beard, wearing a dark green polo shirt and grey chinos

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan family bedroom with a big bed and a mosquito net, seen from the half-open doorway: GIRL caught mid-act, sneakily pulling a gold necklace out from under a pillow, glancing over her shoulder with a guilty grin, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan home kitchen with blue zellige tiles and a teapot on the stove: SISTERINLAW stands with arms crossed and one eyebrow raised, a knowing half-smile, looking toward the hallway, waist-up

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the narrow hallway of a Moroccan house: SISTERINLAW leans toward NARRATOR and quietly asks him something, finger raised; NARRATOR freezes with wide eyes, both faces visible, waist-up

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close waist-up shot in the hallway: NARRATOR sweating and stammering, scratching the back of his head, awkward forced smile, comic panic

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan salon with low sofas and cushions: SISTERINLAW calmly holds out her open palm toward NARRATOR, serious but calm face; NARRATOR shrinks back, embarrassed, both faces visible

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits alone on the edge of a sofa in a Moroccan salon, hand on his chin, puzzled and worried expression, thinking hard, soft afternoon light from a window

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The rooftop terrace of a Moroccan family house with laundry lines: BROTHER, newly married and proud, pats NARRATOR on the shoulder like a big brother; NARRATOR grins cheekily, both faces visible

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the end of a Moroccan hallway: GIRL tiptoeing into a bedroom door, pushing it open slowly with a curious look on her face, face visible, waist-up

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: A married couple's bedroom in a Moroccan house: SISTERINLAW gently tucks a gold necklace under her pillow on the bed, mosquito net above, calm face visible, waist-up
